name: How long does it take to widen a single doorway?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to widen a single doorway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for widening a single doorway can vary depending on its complexity. A straightforward project involving a non-load-bearing wall might take 1-3 days from demolition to finishing, assuming no unexpected issues. If the wall is load-bearing, requires structural engineering, or involves rerouting utilities, the project could extend to 3-7 days or more. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality and minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Widening a doorway typically takes 1-3 days for non-load-bearing walls and 3-7 days or more for load-bearing walls or those requiring utility rerouting.
